---
title: "Bounded Solidarities: The Interconnections of Home, Migrations and Digitization"
subtitle: "RC42 session · XXI ISA World Congress of Sociology, Gwangju 2027"
date: 2027-07-04
author:
  - "Sepetla Molapo"
categories: [Migration, Digitization, Solidarity]
---

The session explores the interconnections of home, migrations, and digitization to examine contemporary forms of solidarity. It examines how migration and digitization have transformed the meaning of home as a space for questioning solidarity, conceptualizing home broadly — both within and beyond state frameworks — and inviting reflections on solidarity in relation to contemporary migration and digitization experiences.

**Organizer(s)/Chair(s):**

- Sepetla Molapo, University of Pretoria & University of South Africa, South Africa

**Host committee(s):** RC42 Social Psychology
